nd.screen.hint: What the monitor plugged into this box shows.
nd.full.hint: A real desktop, fr: NoCapOS sign-in, a dock, Files, Terminal, Settings and your Linux apps. Sign in with this server's Linux accounts.
nd.kiosk.hint: NoCapOS full screen in a browser, still behind the sign-in. Swaps out the full desktop.
nd.off.hint: Just the text console. Nothing graphical runs, pure server energy.
nd.noScreen: No screen detected rn. Plug one in to use NoCap Desktop.
nd.notSetUp: NoCap Desktop isn't set up on this server yet.
nd.confirmBody: Whoever is signed in on the server's screen gets signed out, and unsaved stuff there is gone.
nd.autologin.hint: The server's screen opens your desktop with no password after it starts. Anyone at the screen can use it, so choose wisely.
nd.open.hint: See and use the server's screen right here, in a NoCap Desktop window. Same screen, always: sign in here and you're in on the screen too.
nd.win.signIn: Sign-in screen. Sign in here and the server's screen is in too
nd.win.switching: Following the screen to its new session…
nd.win.closedBody: The screen dipped. The desktop may have restarted or signed out.
nd.win.title: The server's screen
